function core(value: Object) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
  if (typeof value === "number") return value.toFixed();
  return value.toString();
}
function structural(value: { toString(): string }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return value.valueOf();
  return value.toString();
}
function stringShape(value: { length: number }) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
  return value.length;
}
function boxed(value: String) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
  return value.toString();
}
function callable(value: { toString(): string }) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
  return value.toString();
}
function subtract(value: Object) {
  if (typeof value === "number") return "number";
  return value.toString();
}
console.log(core("hello"), core(2), core({}), core(true));
console.log(structural("shape"), structural(false), structural({ toString() { return "custom"; } }));
console.log(stringShape("text"), stringShape({ length: 4 }), boxed("plain"), boxed(new String("boxed")));
console.log(callable(() => "called"), callable(false), subtract(3), subtract("remaining"));
